name: Marine Obsius
source:
Raito's classmate and a god-human hybrid. 

Notably busty, Marine always appears sleepy and distant, yet her academic performance is surprisingly strong. Also known as the information hub of the school, most of the scoop can be had just by asking her. The disparity between her lethargic appearance and her prowess in both academics and information gathering leaves her peers perplexed. Marine chalks it all up to her sleep-learning skills.

She has a devil-may-care personality and usually fools around. Still, she can be reliable in times of need.

"I just absorb all kinds of info in my sleep~♪"

Likes: Sleep, teasing others
Dislikes: None notable

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/subcharacter.html]official website[/url]]
